task.title: Read the LCP element selector from the Lighthouse 12 lcp-discovery-insight audit
task.body:
Why: packages/seo/docs/research/handoff-audit-unlighthouse-quality-2026-10-07.md:190 and packages/seo/docs/research/tool-delivery-roadmap.md:387; packages/seo/src/domain/perf-detail.ts:116-126 only reads `largest-contentful-paint-element`; Lighthouse 12.6.1 builds `lcp-discovery-insight` in node_modules/lighthouse/core/audits/insights/lcp-discovery-insight.js as a `list` whose items include a `node` item.
Outcome: `extractRouteDetail(report, path)` (src/domain/perf-detail.ts) returns `lcpSelector` from the first non-empty source, in this order: (1) the existing `audits["largest-contentful-paint-element"].details.items[0].items[0].node.selector`; (2) otherwise `audits["lcp-discovery-insight"].details` of shape `{ type: "list", items: [...] }`, taking the `selector` string of the first entry in `items` whose `type` is `"node"` (entries of other types such as `"checklist"` are skipped). If neither yields a non-empty string, `lcpSelector` stays `""` and nothing else about the result changes. When both audits are present the legacy one wins. Opportunities, a11y issues and byte totals are unaffected, and `extractRouteDetail` still returns `null` for input without `audits`.
Proof: the implementer adds own tests in tests/domain/perf-detail.test.ts with an insight-only report, a both-present report and a report with neither.

spec: `extractRouteDetail(report, path)` (src/domain/perf-detail.ts) returns `lcpSelector` from the first non-empty source, in this order: (1) the existing `audits["largest-contentful-paint-element"].details.items[0].items[0].node.selector`; (2) otherwise `audits["lcp-discovery-insight"].details` of shape `{ type: "list", items: [...] }`, taking the `selector` string of the first entry in `items` whose `type` is `"node"` (entries of other types such as `"checklist"` are skipped). If neither yields a non-empty string, `lcpSelector` stays `""` and nothing else about the result changes. When both audits are present the legacy one wins. Opportunities, a11y issues and byte totals are unaffected, and `extractRouteDetail` still returns `null` for input without `audits`.
install: npm --prefix packages/seo ci --silent && npm --prefix packages/seo run build --silent
test: cd packages/seo && npx vitest run tests/hidden/hidden.test.ts
